{{Current events|year=2025|month=04|day=29|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**[[2025 India–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
***[[Pakistan]]i Information Minister [[Attaullah Tarar]] says that [[India]] intends to launch a military strike on Pakistan within the next 24 to 36 hours. [https://www.reuters.com/world/pakistans-minister-tarar-says-india-may-launch-military-strike-within-next-24-36-2025-04-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Rif Dimashq clashes (April 2025–present)]]
**Gunmen reported to be aligned with the [[Government of Syria|Syrian government]] engage in fatal clashes with armed [[Druze]] combatants in the Druze-majority city of [[Jaramana]] in southern [[Syria]]. At least 13 people are killed, and 12 others are injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/4/29/sectarian-clashes-kill-13-near-syrian-capital-damascus (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/at-least-10-dead-in-syria-after-sectarian-clashes-in-druze-suburb-of-damascus/ (CTV News)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**At least 26 people are killed when a truck hits a [[roadside bomb]] in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/4/29/roadside-bomb-blast-kills-26-in-nigerias-restive-northeast (Al Jazeera)]
*A 38-year-old man suspected of seriously injuring two women on Saturday in a shooting and [[crossbow]] attack on the [[Otley Run]] pub crawl in [[Leeds]], [[West Yorkshire]], [[England]], succumbs to a self-inflicted gunshot wound in the hospital. It is confirmed that the perpetrator's motive was [[misogyny]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3evygw383eo (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 European power outage]]
**At least five fatalities are reported in [[Spain]] as a consequence of the power outage that affected the Iberian Peninsula the day before. [https://www.abc.es/sociedad/apagon-cobra-cinco-vidas-espana-20250429171025-nt.html (ABC.es)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[:zh:2025年辽宁辽阳饭店火灾|2025 Liaoning Liaoyang Hotel Fire]]
**Twenty-two people are killed and three others are injured after a fire breaks out in a restaurant in [[Liaoyang]], [[Liaoning]], [[China]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/northeast-china-liaoyang-city-beijing-fire-restaurant-kills-injured-5096696 (CNA)]
*Three people are killed and over 400000 lose power due to severe storms in [[Western Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/pittsburgh/news/pittsburgh-power-outages-storm-damage (CBS)]
*Three people are killed and two others are injured when [[scaffolding]] collapses at a developing [[liquefied natural gas]] plant in [[Port Arthur, Texas|Port Arthur]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/us/us-news/port-arthur-texas-3-people-killed-after-scaffold-collapse-at-lng-plant-article-151532396 (Times Now)]
*Fifteen people are killed, including two children, and thirteen others are injured in a fire at a [[hotel]] in [[Kolkata]], [[West Bengal]], India. [https://www.business-standard.com/india-news/kolkata-hotel-fire-falpatti-machhua-rituraj-hotel-kolkata-fire-death-toll-125043000105_1.html (Business Standard)] [https://www.telegraphindia.com/west-bengal/kolkata/kolkata-hotel-fire-three-of-chennai-family-among-14-dead-minister-blames-management/cid/2096803 (The Telegraph)]
*Eighteen [[Russia|Russians]] are injured in a bus crash in [[Side, Turkey|Side]], [[Turkey]]. [https://telegrafi.com/en/Russian-tourist-bus-overturns-in-Turkey--at-least-18-injured/ (''Telegrafi'')]

'''Law and crime'''
* [[Jalisco extermination camp]]
** [[Alejandro Gertz Manero]], [[Attorney General of Mexico]], concluded that the Izaguirre Ranch was used by the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] as a recruitment camp between 2021 and 2024, but found no evidence that it served as an extermination site. [https://www.borderreport.com/regions/mexico/mexicos-attorney-general-says-ranch-was-used-for-cartel-training-but-no-mass-graves-found/ (AP)]

*Three people are killed in a shooting at a [[Beauty salon|hair salon]] in [[Uppsala]], [[Sweden]], with the perpetrator still at large. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr4n9x3yyq5o (BBC News)]
*Three people are killed and two others are seriously injured in a mass shooting in [[Minneapolis]], [[Minnesota]] [https://www.mprnews.org/story/2025/04/30/minneapolis-shooting-multiple-people-dead (Minnesota Public Radio)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[President of Russia]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a decree restoring the "Stalingrad" name to the [[Stalingrad International Airport|Volgograd Airport]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-names-regional-russian-airport-stalingrad-2025-04-29/ (Reuters)]
